beat_plan: Establish: lead with a headline and follow a clear column sequence
Prove: use an approved local capture or truthful designed-motion detail
Payoff: sequential proof with one clear final identity

direction.camera: Guide attention with headline rail; use a deliberate hold, a measured approach and a stable payoff.
direction.composition: lead with a headline and follow a clear column sequence; keep one dominant focal hierarchy and legible supporting evidence.
direction.editing: Open with column rhythm; alternate proof and breathing room, then resolve with sequential proof.
direction.lighting: even reading light; preserve subject contour and separate it from the supporting field.
direction.materials: newsprint and black ink; actual material appearance comes from approved imagery or a real 3D asset.
direction.sound: Create a restrained rhythm around monochrome field; place licensed accents on intentional cuts and keep speech clear.
direction.typography: Use headline rail,column rhythm,archive tone,strong hierarchy,monochrome field,sequential proof as hierarchy cues; keep display copy short and body copy readable at final delivery size.
